QuestInfo.name: To Fight or Not to Fight?
QuestInfo.0: Leafre, the peaceful town of the Halflingers. But Chief Tatamo tells you that Leafre's peace is always threatened. Listen to the details.
QuestInfo.1: Tatamo wants you to go find out if the Halflingers in town believe they should continue to live in Leafre under the protection of the Dragon.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered up the views of the Halflingers in town and delivered that information to Tatamo but there was no decision made.

speech.0: We must point our swords forward and poke them at our enemies! We don't want to be trapped in our own town! We have to show them our power, and then they'll leave us alone.
No war! The dragon eggs will be threatened if there's a war. I'm happy with the way things are!
Only cowards run away! We must march forward and defeat all enemies! Just... don't put me on the front lines.
Hahahaha, war? Are you kidding me? Halflingers aren't built for war! We don't have fangs or claws or strong muscles. Plus we're tiny!
This way, that way... It doesn't really matter.

0.0: Isn't it peaceful out here? Everyone thinks Leafre is so safe, what with the Dragons that protect us, but truth be told, the village's safety is at risk at this very moment.
0.1: Minar Forest is full of danger. Leafre itself is safe, but the minute anyone steps out of town, who knows what'll happen. I wonder what the other Halflingers think about that.

yes.0: Can you ask around town and see what the public opinion is? I swear it's not because I'm too lazy to do it myself.
Mixed response, eh? I guess it's up to me to make the final decision. I wasn't trying to pawn this difficult decision off on the others, I swear.

default.0: This is for your own good. Really.
